bug.title: Authors are told to appeal a hidden post but there is no way to; panel members land on a moderators-only /mod page and see no record of their vote
bug.symptoms: After a moderator hides sam's post, his Needs your attention says 'Appeal the removal of your post on "{title}"'; its Open link shows only "Hidden by moderation: ..." in the thread - there is no Appeal control anywhere (the web's only appeal dialog is the paper-hold one) A drawn panel member following the notice lands at the top of /mod, which first says "Moderators only - your account is tier 3"; the #appeal-... anchor is not scrolled to after client-side navigation (a full reload does scroll) After voting, the vote form shows a blank form again with no "You voted" state; the panel deadline prints as "2026-12-02" while other dates use "18 Nov 2026"
bug.expected: The author of a hidden post (or annotation, or review) sees, on the hidden placeholder in the thread, "Your post was hidden: {reason}. Appeal" which opens an appeal form (statement, signed appeal record whose target is that moderation decision - the appeals API accepts decisions on any record type it already lets moderators decide, with the same one-appeal rule and panel draw); after filing, the placeholder shows "Appeal filed on {date} - awaiting panel" and the attention item disappears; a panel member visiting /mod sees "You're on the appeal panel for {paper title}" first (the moderators-only notice applies only to the moderator queue sections), the page scrolls to and focuses the #appeal-{id} target after client navigation as well as on load, the vote form shows "You voted {choice} on {date}" with an option to change the vote until the panel decides (if the API allows; otherwise read-only), and deadlines use the shared date formatter
bug.actual: Dead-end appeal call to action; confusing panel experience

bug.title: Answered-state wording follows "read", not what the person did; voted panel notices still ask for a vote
bug.symptoms: mei, a guardian who never answered, sees "You approved the recovery request from Hanna Varga." once the request closed - the past-tense wording is derived from read state, not from the guardian's own approval okafor voted on the appeal panel (appeal_panels.vote = upheld, POST 200) and the attention item left, but his notification stays Unread and still says 'Vote on the appeal for "..." by 2026-12-02.' with Open Reporter notices repeat the reporter's category on a line under the sentence; after "You approved" on a recovery request the bell keeps the old count until the next page
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 06 step 7 (screenshots/06-key-recovery/07i-mei-did-not-answer-notification-says-you-approved.png); journey 05 step 6 (screenshots/05-follow-search-notify/06b-okafor-voted-panel-notice-still-asks-to-vote.png); journey 11 step 9 (screenshots/11-moderation-hold-and-appeal/09c-panel-notification-after-vote.png)
bug.expected: A notification's displayed outcome comes from the recorded fact, not from read state: a recovery notice reads "You approved/declined the recovery request from {name} on {date}" only for that guardian's own answer, otherwise "The recovery request from {name} closed ({n} of {m} guardians approved)" or "... was cancelled"; a panel notice becomes "You voted {choice} on the appeal for '{title}'" (marked read) once the member's vote is recorded, or "The panel decided: {outcome}" once decided; an answer resolves its notification server-side at the moment of the action; the notifications card does not repeat a field already in the sentence; any answer made from the dashboard updates the bell count immediately (shared unread state)
bug.actual: Misleading past tense; stale vote request; duplicated line; stale bell

bug.title: Atom/JSON feeds list authors as raw did:key strings and link entries to API JSON
bug.symptoms: The category Atom feed lists each entry's authors as raw did:key strings, and the entry link points at the API's JSON instead of the paper page
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 02: open /c/cs.AI, follow the Atom link (screenshots/02-search-and-discover/05d-atom-feed.png)
bug.expected: Atom and JSON feed entries name authors by profile display name (DID only when no name exists, never after erasure leaks a name), link rel="alternate" to the web paper page (from the configured public web URL), and keep a link to the API record as rel="related"; feed validity tests still pass
bug.actual: DIDs and API links in feeds

bug.title: Review form and report leftovers: Markdown headings render raw; conflict copy and footer text do not fit the state; empty gap above Reveal
bug.symptoms: The form says "Markdown is allowed" but "## Summary" in a report renders as literal "## Summary" (the safe subset has no headings) For a reviewer with an affiliation conflict, the conflict-check copy after commit or reveal still says "the node decides whether it can be committed" An empty gap of about 200px sits above "Reveal review" on the sealed card; the update form footer says it "seals it until it is revealed" although updates are public immediately
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 12 (screenshots/12-review-commit-reveal/06a-anon-reports-reviewer-a.png, and the sealed-card step); journey 13 update form
bug.expected: Reports render Markdown headings (## to ####, mapped below the page's heading level) in the safe subset; the conflict panel's copy reflects the committed/revealed state ("Committed despite a declared affiliation overlap" as a neutral note); the sealed card has no empty gap; the update form's footer states that the update is published immediately (scores and recommendation public, written report per the version's gate)

bug.title: Paper page leftovers: confirmations print raw CIDs, compare shows "types ." with a space, sidebar overflows by 4px, /ai tab title uses the id
bug.symptoms: The appeal-filed and notice-issued confirmations print the raw record CID The compare view's text diff shows "five shift types ." with a space before the period (tokens re-joined with spaces around punctuation) The paper sidebar (aside.ppg-margin) is 4px wider than its column, so a horizontal scrollbar appears under the review cards The standalone /ai/{id} page's document title uses the sch: id instead of the paper title
bug.expected: Confirmations say what happened in words with a link to the record's page (no bare CID; the id may appear in a details disclosure); the word diff preserves the original spacing so punctuation stays attached; the margin column never overflows its track (box-sizing and width fixed, verified by a CSS test); /ai/{id} is titled "AI pre-review · {paper title} · Scholium" like the other standalone pages
